messages:
Clara (Marketing): FYI team: blog + benchmark drops in ~45m. Need one-line exec quote, press kit link, and triage channel. @Diego @Rahul please.
Diego (Comms): Drafting quote. Recommend DM-first to a short list, then staggered regional outreach. Also want a short explainer thread for X.
June (Product): Appendix updated with methodology and configs. Confirm: no customer data used.
Rahul (Legal): Confirmed: include 'No customer data was used.' Use product casing: 'Redwood Optimize'. Avoid predictive claims about Dedicated capacity.
Clara (Marketing): Press kit uploading now; will paste S3 link when ready. Also can we get localized captions for APAC?
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will report any pickup >2k into #press-clips.
Diego (Comms): Exec quote options:
> A: "Redwood Optimize helps teams run inference faster and cheaper in production."
> B: "Our focus with Redwood Optimize is to cut inference cost while preserving latency and quality."
Clara (Marketing): Lean B. Cleaner for social.
Rahul (Legal): Tweak B: change 'quality' to 'user experience'. Approve with that change.
Diego (Comms): Final quote: "Our focus with Redwood Optimize is to cut inference cost while preserving latency and user experience."
Maya (Support): Triage channel prepped: #optimize-press-help. Added quick FAQ + escalation path to eng-runtime.
Clara (Marketing): Press kit: https://s3.internal.redwood.ai/optimize-presskit-1816007777.zip
Diego (Comms): Outreach plan: NA batch (DM 6) now, EU batch T+20m, APAC T+40m local mornings. Hold broad social until I say green.
press-monitor-bot: First DM response: DevWire requesting an on-record engineer quote. Diego to coordinate.
June (Product): I'll provide a 2-paragraph technical note if requested; send me questions in DM.
Diego (Comms): Also prepping a short X thread for tech audience (no raw configs). Will wait to post T+10m after publish if pickups look good.
Clara (Marketing): Reminder: no raw notebook images on social. Point readers to appendix link for reproducibility.
Diego (Comms): Will post status updates here after publish. Keep replies short in this thread so we can have a clean T+1h readout.
